name: GridCraft
cost: Free (MIT or Apache 2.0). No subscription, no licence server, no telemetry
works_with: macOS, Windows, Linux, FreeBSD and the browser; agents through MCP, a CLI or a JSON control channel
short: A free, open-source spreadsheet app in pure Rust with a ribbon, 500+ functions, pivot tables and an MCP server for agents.
what: GridCraft is a clean-room spreadsheet with the layout you already know: ribbon, formula bar, sheet tabs, fill handle and Format Cells. XLSX is its native format, with CSV and TSV too, and it has dynamic arrays, LAMBDA, charts, sparklines and pivot tables. Every button, menu and keystroke is also a command that an agent can run over MCP, the CLI or a JSON control channel.
who: People who want a free desktop spreadsheet, and anyone who wants an agent to read and edit spreadsheets. It's in alpha, and the team estimates it's about 50% ready for real work, so keep your important files in your usual tool for now.
needs: To use it: nothing beyond the download for your system
To build from source: a Rust toolchain with `cargo`
For the web build: trunk and the `wasm32-unknown-unknown` target

steps.title: Download it
steps.text: The latest release on GitHub (https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft/releases/latest) has a signed .msi or portable zip for Windows, a signed .dmg for macOS, and AppImage, Flatpak, .deb, .rpm and tarball builds for Linux. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists a checksum for every file.

steps.title: Or run it from source
steps.text: This opens the desktop app with a sample workbook (sales, budget or grades).

steps.title: Connect your agent over MCP
steps.text: This adds a headless MCP server to Claude Code. It offers tools like `read_range`, `write_range`, `insert_chart` and `execute_command`, which reaches every GridCraft command.
steps.code: claude mcp add gridcraft -- gridcraft-cli mcp

steps.title: If it won't open on Windows
steps.text: Some AMD drivers crash at start. In PowerShell, from the app's folder, try another graphics backend.

try.label: From the README
try.text: Evaluate a formula without opening the app: `gridcraft-cli eval '=XLOOKUP("b",{"a","b"},{1,2})'` returns 2.

watch: It's alpha. Depth, fidelity and file compatibility are still rough, and the team estimates about 50% readiness for real work.
Old .xls files open with values, formulas and number formats but not formatting. XLSB and ODS import data only, using saved values instead of formulas.
The MCP server and control channel let an agent change your workbooks, including real pointer and keyboard input in a running window.
